sections.title: Plane Candidates (unbuilt)
sections.blurb: MTG Planechase planes that map to the Arrival/Static/Chaos/Departure format but aren't built yet. Rules shown are the proposed in-game adaptation; click for art. (8 more — Krosa, Sokenzan, The Hippodrome, Stronghold Furnace, Lethe Lake, Takenuma, Fields of Summer, Minamo — are already in the pool.)

sections.title: Planes Needing Rework
sections.blurb: Planes with real gameplay hooks that would need new engine work or a rework to fit (blocking, flying, mana colours, the planar deck, counters, spell-copy, etc.). Notes flag what each needs.

items.name: Esper
items.note: Needs rework (colour-matters): Static — artifact spells cost 1 less. Chaos — your W/U/B creatures become artifacts.

items.name: Tazeem
items.note: Needs rework (no blocking here): Static — creatures can't block. Chaos — draw a card for each land you control.

items.name: Isle of Vesuva
items.note: Needs copy-on-summon: Static — when a creature enters, summon a copy of it. Chaos — destroy a creature and all others with its name.

items.name: Selesnya Loft Gardens
items.note: Needs token/counter doubling: Static — tokens are made in double. Chaos — your lands add extra mana this turn.

items.name: Academy at Tolaria West
items.note: Static — at end of turn, if your hand is empty, draw 7. Chaos — discard your hand. (needs empty-hand check)

items.name: The Great Forest
items.note: Needs combat rework: Static — creatures deal damage equal to Health. Chaos — your creatures gain +0/+2 and Trample.

items.name: Velis Vel
items.note: Needs tribal-count support: Static — each creature +1/+1 per other creature sharing a tribe. Chaos — a creature gains every tribe.

items.name: Kessig
items.note: Needs Werewolf tribe: Static — non-Werewolves deal no combat damage. Chaos — your creatures become +2/+2 Werewolves with Trample.

items.name: Sea of Sand
items.note: Needs draw-reveal: Static — gain 3 Life when you draw a land. Chaos — put a permanent on top of its owner's deck.

items.name: Windriddle Palaces
items.note: Needs play-from-top: Static — top card of decks revealed; play off the planar deck. Chaos — each player mills a card.

items.name: Stairs to Infinity
items.note: Needs planar-deck hooks: Static — no max hand size; draw when you roll the planar die. Chaos — peek at the planar deck.

items.name: Glimmervoid Basin
items.note: Needs spell-copy: Static — single-target spells copy for each other creature. Chaos — everyone else copies a chosen creature.

items.name: Skybreen
items.note: Needs open-hand: Static — top card revealed; matching-type spells cost more. Chaos — target player loses Life equal to their hand size.

items.name: Agyrem
items.note: Needs colour recursion: Static — white creatures that die return; nonwhite return to hand. Chaos — creatures can't attack you until someone planeswalks.

items.name: Truga Jungle
items.note: Needs mana-fixing: Static — your lands tap for any type. Chaos — reveal the top 3 cards and take the lands.

items.name: Llanowar
items.note: Needs mana ramp: Static — your creatures tap for extra mana. Chaos — untap all your creatures.

items.name: The Zephyr Maze
items.note: Needs Flying keyword: Static — fliers +2/+0, non-fliers -2/-0. Chaos — a creature gains Flying.

items.name: Glen Elendra
items.note: Needs control-swap: Static — swap a creature that dealt combat damage this turn. Chaos — take back control of a creature you own.
